requiredFindings.title: Prepare the census transition against the required current batch-entry baseline
requiredFindings.detail: The lane is actually based on 3742822e, where the discovery receipt is already stale (closure/reference/tool) and no companion receipt exists. The permitted stale checker confirms this and sees only the new reference.generator-closure delta against that base. SCOPE consequently claims no census regeneration is needed and fixes the package to twelve paths. But its integration policy requires waiting until C1a4’s blind refresh; PLAN-r3 LD-C1B-7:153 expressly requires that accepted, current refresh as the batch-entry baseline. On that baseline, changing generator-closure.json stales both receipts: the companion embeds discovery.receipt_bindings in its discovery binding. Both tools then render previously blind-census held-out rows as outstanding/stale, changing their census records even though their pricing source files did not change. The current no-regeneration evidence passes only because the base was already stale/missing, and the stated moved-worktree procedure reruns generation/operability without covering this census transition. It cannot establish the required post-refresh batch opening or the exact twelve-path integration claim.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Keep the schema/code result, but make acceptance/integration evidence use C1a4’s accepted refresh baseline, with its exact current receipt pins and post-run acceptance. Recompute the candidate’s public binding deltas for both receipts, regenerate every census record whose held-out rendering changes, run all three output checks after regeneration, and include the resulting reviewed artifacts in the product map/subject. Preserve the old blind receipts as historical baseline evidence during the stale interval; do not refresh them after C1b-0 or open held-out material. Update prepare/preflight/stale-check logic and SCOPE’s integration/base statements so a permitted base move cannot silently change the reviewed output set. If those baseline artifacts are not available yet, explicitly gate final materialization review on them rather than accepting this already-stale-base run as the batch-entry proof.
